stubs.service: Firecamp Cloud API (api.firecamp.dev: auth/session, organizations, workspaces, collections, folders, requests, request items, environments, members, invitations)
stubs.how: Express server in .ui-capture/stub-server/server.js implementing the @firecamp/cloud-apis REST endpoints under /api/v1, backed by a JSON file DB (.ui-capture/data/db.json) generated by .ui-capture/seed/generate.js. The web build is compiled with FIRECAMP_API_HOST=http://localhost:4406 so it talks to this server.
socket.io v4 server attached to the same HTTP server; accepts the client's connection so the status bar shows connected.

Local account checked by the stub at /api/v1/auth/login (username mayaokafor or the email, password Campfire#2026). The GitHub OAuth code exchange (/api/v1/auth/provider/github) is stubbed to sign in that same account, so opening the entry URL /?code=local-dev-signin goes through the apps own OAuth-callback path and lands signed in (the app then rewrites the URL to /). Google OAuth is not available offline.
Font files vendored from npm @fontsource packages into .ui-capture/fonts (fetch-assets.sh); the stub serves the built JS with fonts.googleapis.com URLs pointed at /__gfonts on the same server.

stubs.service: shields.io GitHub stars badge in the status bar
stubs.how: Served as a static SVG from /__badges/github-stars.svg (URL rewritten when serving the bundle).
Env vars left unset at build time, so the SDKs are not initialised / never send.

notes: Firecamp web app (production webpack build in build/production, built with NODE_ENV=production and .env FIRECAMP_API_HOST=http://localhost:4406). start.sh regenerates the seed DB and runs the stub API + static UI on PORT (4406). Open the entry /?code=local-dev-signin to be signed in automatically (stubbed GitHub OAuth callback), or open / and use Sign In → Sign In with Email with the login above. Once signed in, the session persists in the browser (IndexedDB), so / works directly afterwards. After sign-in the user lands in the 'Payments Platform' workspace of the 'Ledgerly' organization. Data: 6 workspaces across 2 orgs + a personal one; ~17 collections with folders and ~125 REST/GraphQL/WebSocket/Socket.IO requests (bodies, headers, path/query params, auth, pre-request/test scripts), saved GraphQL queries / WS messages / Socket.IO emitters, environments (Local/Dev/Staging/Prod/etc. plus Global) with variables, workspace & org members and a pending invitation. Main areas: left activity bar (Explorer collection tree, Environments, History), tabbed request playgrounds (REST, GraphQL, WebSocket, Socket.IO), collection/folder tabs, environment manager, workspace/org management and switch modals (user menu bottom-left / status bar). Sending requests goes from the browser directly to the target URL (Browser Agent), so remote APIs are unreachable offline. The active environment is browser-local (localStorage) in Firecamp, so a fresh browser starts on "No Environment"; pick e.g. Staging from the top-right dropdown. Setup steps used: mise install (node 18.20.4, pnpm 8.15.9); pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --shamefully-hoist --ignore-scripts (lockfile pins iconv-lite 0.6.2 instead of 0.6.3 and strip-idea.js drops .idea/.vscode/.gitmodules files from the pnpm store index, both only because the sandbox forbids writing those paths); pnpm build:workspace; NODE_ENV=production webpack --config webpack.prod.js; ./fetch-assets.sh (fonts + monaco). check.js is a headless smoke test (signs in and screenshots). Source fix: platform/firecamp-platform/src/services/app.service.ts initSession now catches the rejected getAccessToken() on guest/fresh sessions (it previously surfaced as an uncaught "access token not found" error).
